profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | SEO Engineering & AI Automation | Next.js, Technical SEO, Analytics Dashboards, GSC/GA4
profile.jobTitle: Senior Web Developer & Digital Marketing Manager
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer and SEO engineer building Next.js/TypeScript websites, analytics dashboards, and AI-assisted marketing automation systems.
My recent work spans a few separate lanes: Amity Behavioral Health's four-site healthcare portfolio, contract web/SEO work, and independent product-style builds. At Amity I built and maintained Amity BH, Amity PB, Amity SD, and Surf City Detox across location pages, program pages, blog systems, schema, sitemaps, GA4/GSC analysis, CTM tracking, and conversion paths. The portfolio has generated roughly 5.4K Google Search clicks and 662K impressions across GSC.
I also build operational tools and web properties: a CTM call performance dashboard with live call monitoring, executive KPIs, agent leaderboards, source/campaign analytics, call scoring, webhooks, and historical sync; a Cars Unlimited PB inventory/local SEO platform; VitalBridgeCRM / RCM marketing pages; and the Clubhouse Review editorial site.
I use OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and automation-first workflows to plan SEO calendars, draft and QA content, publish MDX blogs, generate review packets, manage internal linking, verify social/GBP queues, and report clean blockers or no-op outcomes when automation should stop.
Core stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, GA4, Google Search Console, GTM, Looker Studio, CallTrackingMetrics, Postiz, Cloudflare, WP Engine, and WordPress support.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer & Digital Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Built and maintained a four-site Next.js/TypeScript healthcare web portfolio across Amity BH, Amity PB, Amity SD, and Surf City Detox, covering location pages, program pages, blog systems, schema, sitemaps, analytics, and conversion paths.
• Managed SEO operations for roughly 5.4K Google Search clicks and 662K impressions in available 16-month GSC views across the portfolio.
• Built AI-assisted content operations for monthly SEO calendars, briefs, blog drafts, review packets, social/GBP copy, internal-link updates, weekly marketing reports, and quality gates.
• Shipped recurring blog publishing workflows across four behavioral health sites, including MDX publishing, image handling, 1200x630 social assets, schema/indexability checks, builds, Git commits, and production pushes.
• Built the Amity CTM call performance dashboard with live call monitoring, executive KPIs, agent leaderboards, source/campaign analytics, call scoring, webhook ingestion, historical sync, and data reliability tooling.
• Built Postiz-based social and Google Business Profile distribution workflows with live queue verification, media checks, same-day review windows, and explicit failure/no-op reporting.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), SEO Copywriting and +12 skills

positions.title: Founder & Principal — Web Development & Technical SEO
positions.locationName: South Florida, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Founded and operate a productized South Florida SEO and Next.js web development studio — local SEO retainers, fixed-price Next.js + Vercel builds, and senior agency fulfillment for service businesses across local services, multi-location operators, behavioral health/regulated providers, and agency overflow.

• Deliver custom Next.js/TypeScript websites with technical SEO, structured data, conversion paths, and GA4/GTM tracking built in.

• Run productized Local SEO and Google Business Profile retainers — GBP management, citation cleanup, on-page local SEO, service-area pages, and review responses — with monthly Looker Studio reporting tying shipped work to ranking, call, and lead movement.

• Build call tracking and CRM attribution systems (CallTrackingMetrics dynamic source insertion, form attribution, lead routing) so intake, BDC, and sales teams know the source of every conversation.

• Standardized WP Engine + Cloudflare environments (caching/page rules, plugin governance, SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability, release/rollback docs) and accelerated delivery using AI coding tools including Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

• Maintain compliance-aware delivery for regulated verticals — Florida § 397.55, NAATP, and LegitScript-aware content and page standards.

• Provide white-label senior fulfillment for agencies — technical SEO, landing pages, Next.js implementation, and tracking — on monthly reserve or hourly engagements.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), SEO Copywriting and +18 skills

positions.title: Web Development Manager
positions.locationName: Palm Springs, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Managed 12+ WordPress sites for a multi-brand healthcare network on WP Engine
• Led a team of 5 developers; handled hiring, task prioritization, and code review
• Built Python tools for AI-driven landing page personalization and call transcription
• Wrote and edited content across sites: service pages, blog posts, location pages
• Owned technical SEO: site audits, Core Web Vitals improvements, internal linking frameworks, schema implementation
• Built reporting dashboards in GSC and Looker Studio; partnered with content team to prioritize fixes that moved traffic
• Managed DNS, domain migrations, staging-to-production workflows, and plugin governance
• Reduced production incidents through release checklists and uptime monitoring
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), SEO Copywriting and +14 skills

positions.title: Web Developer / Ecommerce Manager
positions.description:
• Grew monthly revenue from $10K to $200K+ through site optimization, mobile UX improvements, and conversion-focused landing pages
• Directed day-to-day operations of two retail locations and a warehouse
• Managed all IT and technical support for retail stores and warehouse operations
• Rebuilt Shopify storefront architecture and checkout flow to reduce drop-offs
• Wrote product descriptions, promo copy, and landing page content
• Ordered, configured, and maintained shop equipment (registers, tablets, office machines)
• Configured GA4 enhanced e-commerce tracking via GTM
• Managed site operations across multiple subsidiary brands
• Provided basic networking support and POS troubleshooting
• Coordinated CDN/caching and image optimization for high-traffic promotional periods
positions.insights: Marketing Strategy, SEO Copywriting and +13 skills
